B is better. It is shorter and closer to the 200-word limit, while covering the same core issues: the un-awaited `forEach`, unhandled rejections, the missing `thumbs` directory, unbounded concurrency, and input validation. Its closing fix suggestion ties the related items together efficiently. Response A is noticeably longer, includes filler ("the first two issues are closely related..."), and spends more words on minor points.

B
